intro: A plate of nasi ulam has about 400 kcal. Most of the calories come from the rice and kerisik. The ulam itself is very low in calories.

breakdown.part: Flaked dried fish or boiled fish

diet: Yes, nasi ulam is one of the lightest rice options. Ulam gives fibre and flavour without many calories. But protein is quite low if there's only a bit of fish. Add a grilled or boiled side for a more balanced meal.
tips: Ask for more ulam and slightly less rice.
Add ikan bakar or a boiled egg for protein.
Take just a little kerisik, it's dense in fat.

swap.name: Nasi ulam with less kerisik + boiled egg
swap.why: About the same calories, but more protein and you stay full longer.

faq.q: What ulam is usually in nasi ulam?
faq.a: Daun kesum, pegaga, daun kaduk, serai, bunga kantan and daun limau purut. Every state has its own mix.

faq.q: What's the difference between nasi ulam and nasi kerabu?
faq.a: Nasi kerabu is usually blue rice with ulam served separately and a sauce. In nasi ulam, the ulam is mixed straight into the rice.

faq.q: Can I make nasi ulam at home?
faq.a: Yes. Slice the ulam finely, then mix with cold rice, kerisik, fish and salt. Easy and fast.
